details:
okay i know people have already posted about this but the more this is posted the better it will get through but anyway this isnt just a complaint post or a post of to just remove something but a post to help you figure out how to work with the community on this

Okay so to start off with, the EAC system, or Easy Anti-Cheat as some know it is to block external applications from modifying the game to make it fair for everyone. BUT VR Chat IS NOT just a game its a place for everyone no matter where you are to make friends and meet people its not something you can win of lose which is what EAC is for making game fair well VR Chat again IS NOT A GAME so don't treat it like one here are the pros and cons of adding it (haven't been on in awhile so I don't know everything myself so some of this may be inaccurate)

Pros:

less modders and people crashing other people 
less lag on servers 
(you get where this is going)

Cons:
Players that are not on probably wont get back on until EAC is removed and mods are controlled and not soft allowed
VR Chat's rating is gonna go way down cause vr chat is going to get boring with the decline in players and that decline is going to lead to more people not wanting to play and leaving reviews about how its boring theres not many people on anymore stuff like that 

also people are just going to find a way around it and mod vrchat more so its sorta point less to add EAC anyway


How to fix this 

this part is to give a suggestion to the vrc team to maybe help them figure out what to do that will make their full community happy.

so with worlds and avatars you upload them through unity and vrc can approve or remove them if they need to well just add something like that for mods you create a mod use a software to upload it to a vrc database and then anyone can enjoy the mod BUT set some fair rules or conditions like the mod cant negatively impact other players or something and it goes through a check before it becomes available to everyone

Conclusion: 
these are just my thoughs on the matter and how i feel about it so
title: Dont Stop mods adapt to them
